record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, compute input-frequency counts by adding 1/sqrt(len(training_history)) for each observed training interaction, then retain the existing normalized log1p transform, square root and attenuation 1-0.3*feature. Downweighting long-history users may make the feature reflect broader user support rather than activity volume. Unseen items retain zero features. Keep embeddings, topology, readout, loss and optimizer fixed; store the feature in the existing checkpoint buffer for identical inference.

category_rationales.rationale: Weight each training interaction by the inverse square root of its user's training-history length. This may reduce long-history users' influence on the frequency feature across all four datasets. Retain the existing transform, attenuation and checkpoint buffer, so inference remains consistent.
